info.title: ITC SAP S/4HANA SD / EWM / FinAgg / NIC GST Cutoff OpenAPI Bundle
info.description: Resolves EOD 21:00 IST CFA billing cutoff blockers across VL02N, VF01, VKM3 FinAgg Credit & NIC E-Way Part-B.

post.summary: Reconciles FEFO batch split lines on picked CFA deliveries and posts Goods Issue (VL02N).

Normalizes vehicle registration number formatting and generates NIC E-Way Bill Part-B.
